annotation.title_clean: 全國法規資料庫會員服務介紹
annotation.title_en: Introduction to Member Services of the National Laws and Regulations Database (captured under the title: Industrial Robot Hazard Prevention Standards)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Justice, Taiwan (全國法規資料庫)
annotation.venue: 全國法規資料庫 (Laws & Regulations Database of the Republic of China)
annotation.summary_en: User guide for the Taiwan National Laws and Regulations Database member services, covering login and personal folders for saving regulations. The collected file does not contain the intended Industrial Robot Hazard Prevention Standards text, so it has no robot governance content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Explains member login via the 'My E-Government' account.
Describes saving favourite regulations to personal folders.
Describes creating, deleting and moving folders and saved items.
Contains no text of the Industrial Robot Hazard Prevention Standards.
